753:t_190:4.en:
$$アル$$
「Let me add one more thing. The Sergeant wishes to see not only Miss $$千鳥かなめ$$ again, but a great many friends and comrades as well.」

753:t_190:6.en:
$$宗介$$
「Affirmative, partner. But I don't believe that dictator playing god is capable of any such thing.」

753:t_190:7.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Your concern is needless. I, an omniscient and omnipotent being...」

753:t_190:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「Enough of your empty talk! You're relentless, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

753:t_190:10.en:
$$宗介$$
「But rest easy. I'll save you the trouble of this new-world business myself! By defeating you and stopping the collapse of the universe!」

753:t_190:11.en:
$$宗介$$
「Prepare yourself, dictator of the universe! However much you put on airs, I'll drag you onto my turf and settle this once and for all!」

753:t_190:12.en:
$$宗介$$
「By losing to a mere soldier... to a single human being, I'll make you suffer the greatest, most unprecedented humiliation in history!!」

753:t_191:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Do you wish to start your life over, too, $$宗介$$?」

753:t_191:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「There's no need to worry. In the new world I lead, too, I'll let you and $$かなめ$$ reunite, having gained new lives.」

753:t_191:3.en:
$$宗介$$
「I have no intention of asking a man like you to play Cupid!」

753:t_191:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Don't be shy. I, an omniscient and omnipotent being...」

753:t_191:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「Enough of your empty talk! You're relentless, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$!」

753:t_191:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「But rest easy. I'll save you the trouble of this new-world business myself! By defeating you and stopping the collapse of the universe!」

753:t_191:8.en:
$$宗介$$
「Prepare yourself, dictator of the universe! However much you put on airs, I'll drag you onto my turf and settle this once and for all!」

753:t_191:9.en:
$$宗介$$
「By losing to a mere soldier... to a single human being, I'll make you suffer the greatest, most unprecedented humiliation in history!!」

753:t_192:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That's right, $$ボン太くん#pilot$$. I am God.」

753:t_192:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Even I cannot allow that.」

753:t_192:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Very well, $$ボン太くん#pilot$$. I will fight you with the fate of the universe at stake!」

753:t_193:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$メリッサ$$... I commend your courage.」

753:t_193:1.en:
$$マオ$$
「That far-too-refreshing smile...! Now that I think about it, you were suspicious from the very start!」

753:t_193:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But you cannot refuse me. Isn't that right, $$メリッサ$$?」

753:t_193:3.en:
$$マオ$$
「Don't go calling people by their names so casually! I don't know how confident you are, but $$クルツ$$ is several times better looking than you!」

753:t_193:4.en:
$$マオ$$
「Get out of my way, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! In my life, you're nothing but a nuisance!!」

753:t_194:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Lower your gun, $$クルツ$$. If you have time for futile resistance, spend your last moments with the one you love.」

753:t_194:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Mind your own business, Peeping Tom God! Quit grinning in the face of the universe collapsing!」

753:t_194:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「As a god, I will watch the universe collapse... That is my mission.」

753:t_194:3.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Don't make me laugh! What it comes down to is you're a loser who waved a white flag at the universe!」

753:t_194:4.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Get out of my way, you fraud! You think I'll let a phony nice guy like you get in the way of my future with $$メリッサ$$!!」

753:t_195:0.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「To think I'd end up saving not just the world but the universe...! Even I didn't see that coming!」

753:t_195:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But, $$ベン$$... You have regrets.」

753:t_195:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「That if the universe was going to perish anyway, you should have quit $$ミスリル$$ right away and moved to $$アキハバラ$$.」

753:t_195:3.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Don't use a man's dreams to rattle him!」

753:t_195:4.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「I'll make that dream come true after I get past you! There's no way I'll allow this universe to perish before that series reaches its final episode!!」

753:t_196:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$ゼロ$$... no, $$ルルーシュ$$. Your days of battle filled with regret end here.」

753:t_196:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I don't mind my own end. But I cannot stand by while the lives of people who seek the future are stolen by someone's ego!」

753:t_196:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「This is the will of the universe. I accepted it, and was given the role of carrying this world's memories to the new world.」

753:t_196:3.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Selfish logic! Know that it was your giving up that accelerated the force that seeks to vanish!」

753:t_196:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Time is running short. I will indulge your irresponsible accusations no further.」

753:t_196:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Fine, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. But I intend to take responsibility for what I said.」

753:t_196:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「And even if my life ends here, I will carve out what lies ahead... the future!」

753:t_196:7.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! By defeating you, a fraud who poses as a god!」

753:t_196:8.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Do you still not understand that it is futile, $$ルルーシュ$$!」

753:t_196:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Silence, you who obstruct the future! My name is $$ゼロ$$...!」

753:t_196:10.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The man who works the miracle of victory!!」

753:t_197:0.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「How does it feel, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$? To have the eternity you all cling to taken away?」

753:t_197:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$... What a woman you are...」

753:t_197:2.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You, who treasure something like eternity, are dull beings.」

753:t_197:3.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「You don't understand the meaning or value of life, which is how you could watch everything perish with a smile.」

753:t_197:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But with this $$至高神Ｚ$$, I can overcome the collapse of the universe! And if I then obtain the $$スフィア$$s anew afterward...!」

753:t_197:5.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「That's enough, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$. You're already finished.」

753:t_197:6.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「From here on, humans... those who know the meaning of life, will create the future!」

753:t_198:0.en:
$$カレン$$
「It's over, $$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'll repay every debt I owe you right here!」

753:t_198:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You fight to settle a grudge, $$カレン$$... A woman fighting for something so petty should indeed perish here along with the old world.」

753:t_198:2.en:
$$カレン$$
「Give me a break! I want what lies beyond... the future!」

753:t_198:3.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'm nothing like you, someone who smiles and watches people die just to protect their own pride!!」

753:t_198:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Do you, too, think my resolve as a god amounts to only that?」

753:t_198:5.en:
$$カレン$$
「What resolve?! Don't gloss over giving up with pretty words!」

753:t_198:6.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'll fight with everything I've got! Against you, and against the will of the universe!」

753:t_198:7.en:
$$カレン$$
「And I'll win, no matter what! I want a future, and so does everyone else!!」

753:t_199:0.en:
$$スザク$$
「Is now the time to put my life on the line...!」

753:t_199:1.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「If it is retribution to atone for your sins that you seek, $$スザク$$... I will grant it myself.」

753:t_199:2.en:
$$スザク$$
「That won't do! Casting aside everything to defeat you is the mission I've been given!!」

753:t_199:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「You intend to surpass me, in your ignorance of your place?」

753:t_199:4.en:
$$スザク$$
「I'll teach you, who fell into eternity and forgot the meaning of life! The strength of humans who stake their lives!」

753:t_199:5.en:
$$スザク$$
「$$ユフィ$$, Father...! To protect the future, I'll fight alongside $$ルルーシュ$$!」

753:t_199:6.en:
$$スザク$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! I'll stake everything I have to defeat you!!」

753:t_200:0.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「$$キリコ$$... You, the $$異能生存体$$, are a miracle born of the universe's whim.」

753:t_200:2.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「But I am a being who has surpassed even that. Therefore I can also end your days of battle.」

753:t_200:3.en:
$$キリコ$$
「$$異能生存体$$... That power threw me into the flames of battle.」

753:t_200:4.en:
$$キリコ$$
「But there, I gained... something irreplaceable.」

753:t_200:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「Don't put on a brave front, $$キリコ$$. I am the one who will save you.」
